The parser registers only `--timeout`, although `docs/adr/007-timeout.md:5` promises to accept `--wait` for one release with a deprecation warning. Register the legacy alias with the `timeout` destination, emit the promised warning, and add a regression test for that invocation. — Existing scripts using `--wait` fail during the promised compatibility period.
